build_time_series_lagged_features: build time series lagged features from a Polars DataFrame using shift and rolling aggregations on a count column
train_histgradientboosting_regressor: train a HistGradientBoostingRegressor model on lagged time series features for bike demand forecasting
evaluate_with_timeseries_split: evaluate time series model using TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation with gap and max_train_size parameters
